truncateTooltipLabel.description:
Whether or not to truncate the series labels if they are longer than the default allowed size
If 'false', increases tooltip size to wrap the longest series label. Takes priority over the size field.

truncateTooltipHeader.description:
Whether or not to truncate the header text of the tooltip if it is longer than the default allowed size
The maximum allowed size will depend on the size property which ranges from "xs" (extra small) to "xl" (extra large)
